author: <PLACEHOLDER/author: the writer's name, filled in before review>

main.applies_while: at each run (the pre-landing safeguard, F and landing) main is resolved by git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main, and the record applies only if R13 and R1-R12 all hold there (R13, the ledger binding, first). The record names no later main commit; a different AGENTS.md blob at main needs a new record with supersedes

ledger.note: the ledger at P, from which ledger_binding was computed; the ledger used at a run is the configuration's adapters.ledger, bound by R13

ledger_binding.canonical_json: json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded as UTF-8, then sha256

paths.resolution: L:AGENTS.md = main's AGENTS.md with C's splices applied at main-translated offsets, each old_sha256 re-verified against main (DESIGN-v5.1 sec. 13.1; v2 sec. 13.2 'both changed')

unchanged_ledgered.note: informational: the number of other files entries in the ledger at P. R10 checks every files entry of the run's ledger, whatever their number

unchanged_corpus.rule: no papers/ or book/ path and no generated corpus artifact differs between H and main (evaluated at run time; not a recorded list)

entries.check: ledger binding, checked first: the run's ledger has base = scientific_base, and its AGENTS.md files entry, its AGENTS.md splice list and the run's edit-list records for AGENTS.md have the canonical sha256 values of ledger_binding (canonical: util.canonical of the Stage 1 engine, i.e. sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8); otherwise the record does not apply and a superseding record is needed

main is resolved by git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main at each run (the pre-landing safeguard, F and landing); H is on main's first-parent chain; the first-parent commits on H..main that change AGENTS.md equal paths[0].side_change_commits
AGENTS.md at main has git blob id paths[0].m and sha256 paths[0].m_sha256
uniqueness at H: the overlapping occurrence count of D296's old bytes (from the run's edit list, bound by R13) is 1, at start_H; sha256(H[start_H:end_H]) = old_sha256
uniqueness at main: the same count is 1, at start_M; sha256(main[start_M:end_M]) = old_sha256

translation: the common byte prefix of H and main is >= end_H, so the translation is the identity (otherwise the recorded delta equals the length change before start_H and no main_changes range meets [start_M, end_M))

approved text, with new and new_sha256 from the run's ledger and edit list (bound by R13): Lx = main[:start_M] + new + main[end_M:]; Lx[start_M:start_M+len(new)] = new; sha256(new) = new_sha256; lines 36-39 of Lx equal those of H + D296 (T1')
expected landing blob: git blob id and sha256 of Lx = paths[0].l and l_sha256
expected candidate blob: git blob id and sha256 of H + D296 = paths[0].x and x_sha256 = the expected_sha256 of the AGENTS.md entry of the run's ledger (bound by R13), and T1''s blob

protected sections untouched: each header in protected occurs once in main and once in Lx at a >= end_M; Lx[a+delta:b+delta] = main[a:b] with the recorded sha256; and Lx[end_M+delta:] = main[end_M:]. The owner's condition names §A.49; §A.50 is listed because it follows §A.49 and is covered by the same suffix check
every files entry of the run's ledger other than AGENTS.md, whatever their number: blob at main equals blob at H, and sha256 equals its base_sha256

git diff --name-status H main lists no corpus path and no generated corpus artifact; every other changed path is covered by a referenced side-change class record whose pinned blob matches, or by another reviewed class record (the tool's landing paths; the plan amendment's paths if they are on main before F)
